title: Bind x1 lifecycle assertions to the immutable x1 Git object
failure_signature: Two current-phase tests failed because x1-only absence and Method Flow cardinality were asserted against a live x2 working tree.
candidate_workaround: Check x2 absence against the exact x1 Git object and check x1 Method Flow records as a preserved identified subset while allowing later append-only methods and witnesses.
recurrence_guard: Lifecycle tests must state whether their domain is an immutable commit or the current head; never infer historical contamination from legitimate additive later-phase files.
rollback: Retain the two-test failure, award no current-suite credit, and change only the time-domain assertions before rerunning the same 26 tests.
scope_boundary: Owner-local lifecycle test semantics only; no scientific, authority, production, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
